disagreements.note: the HIA disagrees with itself by 0.5 m; the 2010 LiDAR (ridge at b = -6.74, south eave about b = -14.4) favours the CAD 13.635

disagreements.note: resolved 2026-10-30: Fig 15 (the existing plan) carries the west wall to 5.0 m on its scale, the men's toilet 3.4 m deep with an open lobby south of it; the CAD's 3.13 is the proposed meter room. The hia plan now uses 4.84
the photo and the HIA agree; the sheet square is ~1 m north of both
